asset_findings.evidence_notes: Viewed the exact 1440x1040 PNG again in this final review and in every bound rendition that uses it. Three non-overlapping employer groups show private goods +18, private services +28 and government -17 thousand jobs. The zero line separates positive and negative changes; signs, lengths, category labels and unit are correct. Values reconcile to total nonfarm +29; government is the code-derived 29 minus 46, also matching the change in total-minus-private levels. The September reference period, seasonally adjusted basis and 2 October 2026 release date are visible; the bound caption supplies preliminary-estimate status and the derivation. No forecast, stacked duplicate subtotal, invented missing observation or October outcome appears. Full source pixels are crisp; on mobile the fine internal type is small but normal-sized captions repeat the essential figures, date, units and source.

Viewed the exact 1440x1040 PNG again in this final review and each bound rendition that uses it. The single nominal 10-year Treasury par-yield line agrees with the exact 45 dated observations from 1 September through 4 November 2026. Its final point and legend read 4.90%; the early-October peak agrees with the 5.31% 5 October observation cited in the article. Percent units, date window and Treasury/Capital Chronicle source line are present. The explicitly visible yield-axis range is suitable for this level series; no zero-baseline claim is implied. No dual axis, equity overlay, causal arrow, imputed holiday observation, smoothing or forecast is shown. The full image is unclipped and readable. Mobile captions preserve the final value, exact period and source while the detailed axis/source type is small.

Viewed the exact 3000x2041 local photograph again and the canonical desktop/mobile placements. It shows the exterior front facade and entrance of the Eccles Building with no distortion or misleading crop. The visible canonical caption identifies March 2011 archive context; it does not suggest a current meeting, a jobs-release scene or corroboration of employment figures. The caption, alt text and creator/source identity agree. The retained hash-verified licence receipt identifies a Board of Governors work under the Federal Reserve public-domain template, with the regional-bank distinction preserved. Canonical credit visibly retains Federalreserve/Federal Reserve Board, Wikimedia Commons, source and public-domain licence links. The photograph is used for institutional rate context and does not appear as a factual chart or a contemporary event photo.
